Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].cChildren As 'AddCalculatedMembers([Trips].[Pickup area].currentmember.children).count' Set FilteredMembers As '{[Trips].[Pickup area].[All]}' Select {[Measures].cChildren} on ROWS, Hierarchize(Generate(FilteredMembers, Ascendants([Trips].[Pickup area].currentmember))) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME, MEMBER_TYPE ON COLUMNS FROM [DS_SAMPLES]
